form.reasonHelp: Kept in the record's history and the audit log.

errors.notFound: This record is gone or you can no longer see it. Reload the list.
errors.conflict: Another record already holds these values. Change them and save again.
errors.invalid: A value is outside what this field accepts. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.unexpected: The change did not save because of a problem on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.fixFields: Fix the highlighted fields and save again.
errors.endAfterStart: The end comes after the start.
errors.reason: Write a reason of up to 500 characters.
errors.nothingToPublish: There are no drafted shifts in this view to publish.
errors.breakMinutes: Break minutes are a whole number from 0 to 1440.
errors.name: Enter a name of up to 200 characters.
errors.combination: Choose a pay basis and arrangement that the classification permits.
errors.money: Enter an amount with at most two decimals, or leave it blank for Unpriced.
errors.moneyRequired: Enter the rate as an amount with at most two decimals.
errors.hours: Enter the hours as a number above zero.

refusals.shift_accept_rpc: Only the person on the shift accepts it, or a crew member claims it while it is open.
refusals.shift_already_claimed: Someone already holds this shift. Choose another open shift.
refusals.shift_not_published: Only a published open shift can be claimed. Ask the planner to publish it.
refusals.shift_double_booked: You already hold a shift that overlaps this one. Swap or release that shift first.
refusals.shift_state_conflict: The shift changed state since you opened it. Reload to see its current state.
refusals.shift_transition_not_allowed: A shift cannot make that move. Its history shows the moves it has made.
refusals.shift_canceled: A canceled shift keeps its times and person. Plan a new shift instead.
refusals.shift_record: A shift staffs a Shift record of its own project. Choose a record from this project.
refusals.shift_scope_project: The scope node belongs to another project. Choose one from this project.
refusals.swap_not_on_shift: Only the person on the shift asks to swap it.
refusals.swap_stale: The shift changed hands since the swap was asked for. Reject this swap and ask again.
refusals.swap_state_conflict: The swap was already decided. Reload to see its current state.
refusals.sod_swap_requester: Neither person in a swap can approve it. Ask another supervisor.
refusals.time_entry_overlap: This person already has time recorded for part of that period, possibly from another device. Clock out of the open entry first.
refusals.time_entry_project: People record time only on projects they belong to or hold a shift on.
refusals.time_entry_shift: The entry must work a shift of the same person and project.
refusals.time_entry_immutable: A time entry keeps its person and project. Void it and record a new one.
refusals.production_closed: This production is closed, so it takes no new time. Reopen it from the project to record time.
refusals.correction_immutable: A decided correction never changes. Request a new correction.
refusals.sod_approval_requester: You requested this, so someone else approves it.
refusals.sod_timesheet_submitter: The worker and the submitter cannot approve this timesheet. Ask another approver.
refusals.timesheet_open_entry: An entry in this period is still clocked in. Clock out of it before submitting.
refusals.timesheet_immutable: A submitted timesheet keeps its period, project and person.
refusals.timesheet_state_conflict: The timesheet changed state since you opened it. Reload to see its current state.
refusals.timesheet_transition_not_allowed: A timesheet cannot make that move from its current state.
refusals.pay_period_overlap: Pay periods never overlap. Choose dates outside the existing periods.
refusals.pay_period_dates_locked: A pay period's dates change only while it is Open.
refusals.pay_period_runs_open: Every payroll run of the period must be Accepted or Canceled before the period posts.
refusals.pay_period_transition_not_allowed: A posted pay period never reopens, and a period cannot skip a step.
refusals.pay_period_state_conflict: The pay period changed state since you opened it. Reload to see its current state.
refusals.pay_period_posted: This pay period is posted and accepts no payroll changes.
refusals.payroll_run_transition_not_allowed: A payroll run moves through Calculated, Approved and Exported in order.
refusals.payroll_run_state_conflict: The payroll run changed state since you opened it. Reload to see its current state.
refusals.payroll_run_not_calculated: Only a calculated payroll run can be approved. Calculate it first.
refusals.payroll_run_not_draft: Only a draft payroll run is calculated. Return it to Draft first.
refusals.payroll_run_not_approved: Only an approved payroll run is exported. Approve it first.
refusals.payroll_run_locked: Payroll lines change only while the run is Draft or Calculated.
refusals.payroll_earning_code_missing: Add a regular earning code in Payroll and Time Off settings, then calculate again.
refusals.payroll_overtime_code_missing: Overtime was worked. Add an overtime earning code in Payroll and Time Off settings, then calculate again.
refusals.payroll_rate_missing: Someone on an approved timesheet has no pay rate in this currency. Record one in the pay rate ledger, then calculate again.
refusals.payroll_wage_rule_missing: A project on an approved timesheet has no jurisdiction with a wage-hour rule, so overtime has no answer. Set the project's jurisdiction.
refusals.payroll_export_changed: The payroll lines changed since this file was produced. Produce a new export.
refusals.plan_feature_required: Payroll export is included from the Team plan. An Owner can upgrade in Billing and Plan.
refusals.export_restricted: A payroll export carries Restricted pay rates. Ask an Owner to produce it.
refusals.step_up_required: Exporting Restricted pay data needs step-up authentication. Verify with your second factor, then try again.
refusals.spend_unpriced: An unpriced amount cannot be approved. Price every line first.
refusals.spend_authority_missing: No spend authority covers this payroll run for your role. An Owner sets limits in Spend Authority settings.
refusals.spend_authority_exceeded: This payroll run is above your spend limit. It goes to the next approver.
refusals.spend_approval_duplicate: You already approved this run. A second approval needs a different approver.
refusals.sod_time_off_requester: You cannot approve your own time off. Ask another approver.
refusals.time_off_state_conflict: The request changed state since you opened it. Reload to see its current state.
refusals.time_off_transition_not_allowed: The request cannot make that move from its current state.
refusals.transition_reason_required: Every state change carries a reason. Write one and try again.
refusals.time_zone_unknown: The time zone is not an IANA zone. Set the project's time zone.
refusals.other: The change was refused by rule {rule}. Check the record and try again, or ask an administrator.
refusals.requisition_unpriced: A requisition needs a rate and the units per person before it is approved. Edit it to price it.
refusals.requisition_locked: A requisition's role, terms and headcount change only while it waits for approval.
refusals.requisition_state_conflict: The requisition changed state since you opened it. Reload to see its current state.
refusals.requisition_transition_not_allowed: A requisition cannot make that move from its current state.
refusals.requisition_scope_project: The scope node belongs to another project.
refusals.requisition_budget_project: The budget line belongs to another project.
refusals.requisition_currency: The requisition's currency differs from its budget's. Use the budget currency.
refusals.role_assignment_immutable: A role assignment keeps its project, person and role. End it and assign again.
refusals.role_assignment_basis: That staffing basis does not match the canon role. Choose Declared, or the basis the role is staffed on.
refusals.role_assignment_requisition: A role assignment fills an approved requisition of its own project.
refusals.role_assignment_person: Assign an active member of the org. External people work through engagements in Opportunities.
refusals.role_assignment_state_conflict: The role assignment changed state since you opened it. Reload to see its current state.
refusals.role_assignment_transition_not_allowed: A role assignment cannot make that move from its current state.
refusals.agreement_signed_permanent: A signed agreement is never revoked, unsigned or edited. Supersede it with a new agreement.
refusals.agreement_immutable: An agreement keeps its kind, project, offer and parties.
refusals.agreement_locked: An agreement's text changes only while it is a draft. Recall it first.
refusals.agreement_state_conflict: The agreement changed state since you opened it. Reload to see its current state.
refusals.agreement_transition_not_allowed: An agreement cannot make that move from its current state.
refusals.agreement_token_validity: A signing link is valid for 1 to 90 days.
refusals.credential_self_issue: Nobody records their own certificate. Ask another verifier to record it.
refusals.certification_holder_immutable: A certificate record keeps its holder, verifier and code. Remove it and record it again.
refusals.swap_not_allowed: This project does not allow shift swaps. Ask your supervisor to cover the shift.
refusals.swap_needs_approval: A supervisor approves swaps on this project. Wait for their decision.
refusals.shift_claim_waiting: You already claimed this shift. A supervisor decides.
refusals.shift_claim_decided: This claim was already decided or withdrawn. Reload to see where it stands.
refusals.shift_claim_reason: Say why the claim is rejected.
refusals.shift_claim_not_most_senior: Under the seniority rule the shift goes to the most senior claimant. Use Give to the most senior.
refusals.shift_claim_none: Nobody is waiting on this shift.
refusals.sod_shift_claim_self: You cannot approve your own claim. Another supervisor decides it.
refusals.punch_location_required: This project needs your location to clock in. Clock in on site from Compass with location on.
refusals.punch_outside_geofence: You are outside the project's geofence. Clock in on site.

payroll.secondApprover: Your approval is recorded. This run is above the dual approval threshold, so a second approver finishes it.
payroll.calculateHelp: Lines are written from approved timesheets of the period at the pay rate in force, with weekly overtime under the canon wage-hour rule.
payroll.approveHelp: Approval runs under your spend authority. Above the dual threshold a second approver finishes it.

payroll.planTitle: Payroll export needs the Team plan
payroll.maskedBody: Rates and amounts are Restricted. Hours show; rates and totals read Masked for your role.
payroll.noLinesDraft: No lines yet. Calculate the run to write them from approved timesheets.
payroll.postHelp: A posted period never reopens and accepts no payroll changes. Every run must be Accepted or Canceled first.
payroll.reopenReason: A late timesheet needs to be included.
payroll.noRunsOpen: No runs yet. Start a payroll run for this period.
payroll.noRuns: No payroll runs in this period.
payroll.emptyWriter: No pay periods yet. Set the first period you run payroll on.
payroll.emptyReader: No pay periods yet. A payroll manager opens them.
payroll.noExports: No exports yet. Approve a payroll run in Pay Periods, then produce its file here.
payroll.noExportsPlan: Payroll exports start on the Team plan. Your timesheets and payroll runs stay available on every plan.
